question:
Simplify the following expression.

 ((a² + b² - c²)² - (a² - b² + c²)²)/(b² - c²)
solution:
**Given:**

 ((a² + b² - c²)² - (a² - b² + c²)²)/(b² - c²)

**Formula used:**

a² - b² = (a + b)(a - b)

**Calculation:**

 ((a² + b² - c²)² - (a² - b² + c²)²)/(b² - c²)
